Read the passage and answer the question:

Water resource management in rapidly expanding metropolitan centers has emerged as one of the most critical governance challenges of the twenty-first century. Decades of unmitigated urban sprawl, coupled with erratic precipitation patterns induced by global climate change, have severely depleted municipal aquifers and destabilized traditional watershed ecosystems. Traditional command-and-control policies, characterized by centralized bureaucratic distribution and heavy reliance on large-scale concrete dams, have proven increasingly inadequate against these complex ecological pressures. Contemporary urban planners now advocate for a paradigm shift toward integrated water resource management (IWRM), which combines decentralized rainwater harvesting, stringent industrial effluent regulations, and community-led watershed restoration. Furthermore, smart metering and AI-driven leak detection networks can drastically reduce non-revenue water losses in aging municipal pipes. However, technological interventions alone cannot succeed without addressing deep-seated socioeconomic disparities; informal settlements frequently lack legal piped connections, forcing vulnerable urban residents to purchase water from predatory private vendors at exorbitant rates. True water security, therefore, requires both technical modernization and equitable social policy.

Q. According to the passage, what has rendered traditional command-and-control water policies increasingly inadequate?

(A) The complete absence of municipal pipes and government buildings in metropolitan areas.
(B) Complex ecological pressures such as unmitigated urban sprawl and climate-induced erratic precipitation.
(C) The immediate global ban on all large-scale concrete dams by international environmental treaties.
(D) The absolute refusal of informal settlements to use rainwater harvesting technologies.
answer: (B) Complex ecological pressures such as unmitigated urban sprawl and climate-induced erratic precipitation.

(B) Complex ecological pressures such as unmitigated urban sprawl and climate-induced erratic precipitation.
(C) The immediate global ban on all large-scale concrete dams by international environmental treaties.
(D) The absolute refusal of informal settlements to use rainwater harvesting technologies.

Read the passage and answer the question:

Water resource management in rapidly expanding metropolitan centers has emerged as one of the most critical governance challenges of the twenty-first century. Decades of unmitigated urban sprawl, coupled with erratic precipitation patterns induced by global climate change, have severely depleted municipal aquifers and destabilized traditional watershed ecosystems. Traditional command-and-control policies, characterized by centralized bureaucratic distribution and heavy reliance on large-scale concrete dams, have proven increasingly inadequate against these complex ecological pressures. Contemporary urban planners now advocate for a paradigm shift toward integrated water resource management (IWRM), which combines decentralized rainwater harvesting, stringent industrial effluent regulations, and community-led watershed restoration. Furthermore, smart metering and AI-driven leak detection networks can drastically reduce non-revenue water losses in aging municipal pipes. However, technological interventions alone cannot succeed without addressing deep-seated socioeconomic disparities; informal settlements frequently lack legal piped connections, forcing vulnerable urban residents to purchase water from predatory private vendors at exorbitant rates. True water security, therefore, requires both technical modernization and equitable social policy.

Q. Consider the following statements based on the passage:
(I) Traditional command-and-control water policies have successfully resolved modern ecological pressures in metropolitan areas.
(II) Integrated water resource management (IWRM) incorporates decentralized rainwater harvesting and community-led watershed restoration.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

(A) Only (I)
(B) Only (II)
(C) Both (I) and (II)
(D) Neither (I) nor (II)
options: (A) Only (I)
(B) Only (II)
(C) Both (I) and (II)
(D) Neither (I) nor (II)
explanation: Statement (I) is incorrect because the passage explicitly states that traditional command-and-control policies have proven 'increasingly inadequate' against complex ecological pressures. Statement (II) is correct as the text notes that IWRM 'combines decentralized rainwater harvesting... and community-led watershed restoration.' Thus, only statement (II) is correct.

answer: B) Facilitators and curators of credible information

question:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Digital transformation in modern education has altered the traditional student-teacher dynamic, shifting the focus from passive content absorption to interactive digital engagement. While online platforms, virtual learning environments, and artificial intelligence-driven tutors democratize access to knowledge across geographical barriers, they also introduce significant pedagogical challenges. Chief among these is the widening digital divide, which disadvantages learners from marginalized socioeconomic backgrounds who lack reliable internet connectivity or advanced hardware. Furthermore, the sheer volume of unfiltered information available on the internet requires a higher level of critical media literacy than previous generations needed. Educators are no longer mere dispensers of facts; they must act as facilitators and curators of credible information, guiding students through an overwhelming sea of data. Critics argue that excessive reliance on digital mediums can diminish interpersonal social skills and emotional intelligence among young learners. Yet, when implemented judiciously, technology does not replace the human element in teaching; rather, it amplifies the teacher's capacity to personalize instruction and cater to diverse learning paces.

Q. Based on the passage, which of the following statements are correct?
(I) Digital tools can help personalize instruction for diverse learning paces.
(II) The digital divide equally impacts all socioeconomic groups without distinction.
(III) Unfiltered online information necessitates enhanced critical media literacy.

A) (I) and (II) only
B) (II) and (III) only
C) (I) and (III) only
D) (I), (II) and (III)
options: A) (I) and (II) only
B) (II) and (III) only
C) (I) and (III) only
D) (I), (II) and (III)
explanation: Statement (I) is correct as the text notes technology amplifies the teacher's capacity to personalize instruction. Statement (III) is correct because unfiltered information requires critical media literacy. Statement (II) is incorrect because the digital divide disadvantages learners from marginalized backgrounds, not all groups equally.

गद्यांश को पढ़िए और प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

आधुनिक शिक्षा में डिजिटल परिवर्तन ने पारंपरिक छात्र-शिक्षक गतिशीलता को बदल दिया है, जिसमें ध्यान निष्क्रिय सामग्री ग्रहण से इंटरैक्टिव डिजिटल जुड़ाव की ओर स्थानांतरित हो गया है। हालांकि ऑनलाइन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म, वर्चुअल लर्निंग वातावरण और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस-संचालित ट्यूटर भौगोलिक बाधाओं से परे ज्ञान तक पहुंच का लोकतंत्रीकरण करते हैं, वे महत्वपूर्ण शैक्षणिक चुनौतियां भी पैदा करते हैं। इनमें सबसे प्रमुख व्यापक डिजिटल विभाजन है, जो हाशिए की सामाजिक-आर्थिक पृष्ठभूमि के शिक्षार्थियों को नुकसान पहुंचाता है जिनके पास विश्वसनीय इंटरनेट कनेक्टिविटी या उन्नत हार्डवेयर की कमी है। इसके अलावा, इंटरनेट पर उपलब्ध अंसिथत जानकारी की भारी मात्रा के लिए पिछले पीढ़ियों की तुलना में अधिक स्तर की महत्वपूर्ण मीडिया साक्षरता की आवश्यकता होती है। शिक्षक अब केवल तथ्यों के वितरक नहीं हैं; उन्हें विश्वसनीय जानकारी के सूत्रधार और क्यूरेटर के रूप में कार्य करना चाहिए, जो छात्रों को डेटा के भारी समुद्र के माध्यम से मार्गदर्शन करते हैं। आलोचकों का तर्क है कि डिजिटल माध्यमों पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता युवा शिक्षार्थियों के बीच पारस्परिक सामाजिक कौशल और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता को कम कर सकती है। फिर भी, जब समझदारी से लागू किया जाता है, तो प्रौद्योगिकी शिक्षण में मानवीय तत्व को प्रतिस्थापित नहीं करती है; बल्कि, यह व्यक्तिगत निर्देश और विविध सीखने की गति को पूरा करने की शिक्षक की क्षमता को बढ़ाती है。

Q. गद्यांश के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
(I) डिजिटल उपकरण विभिन्न सीखने की गति के लिए व्यक्तिगत निर्देश को निजीकृत करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।
(II) डिजिटल विभाजन बिना किसी भेद के सभी सामाजिक-आर्थिक समूहों को समान रूप से प्रभावित करता है।
(III) अंसिथत ऑनलाइन जानकारी के लिए उन्नत महत्वपूर्ण मीडिया साक्षरता की आवश्यकता होती है।

A) केवल (I) और (II)
B) केवल (II) और (III)
C) केवल (I) और (III)
D) (I), (II) और (III)
options_hi: A) केवल (I) और (II)
B) केवल (II) और (III)
C) केवल (I) और (III)
D) (I), (II) and (III)
explanation_hi: कथन (I) सही है क्योंकि पाठ नोट करता है कि प्रौद्योगिकी व्यक्तिगत निर्देश को निजीकृत करने की शिक्षक की क्षमता को बढ़ाती है। कथन (III) सही है क्योंकि अंसिथत जानकारी के लिए महत्वपूर्ण मीडिया साक्षरता की आवश्यकता होती है। कथन (II) गलत है क्योंकि डिजिटल विभाजन हाशिए की पृष्ठभूमि वाले शिक्षार्थियों को नुकसान पहुंचाता है, सभी समूहों को समान रूप से नहीं।
